resources.string: Switch on your piano and its Bluetooth. Tap it in the list to connect.
No piano found yet. Check that its Bluetooth is on, then press Search again.
Could not connect. Tap to try again.
This device has no Bluetooth. Connect your piano over USB instead.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to pair your piano.
To find your piano, Practice Piano needs the Nearby devices permission. Allow it in Settings, then pair again.
To find Bluetooth pianos, Android 10 and 11 need the Location permission. Allow it in Settings, then pair again.
Android 10 and 11 only find Bluetooth devices while Location is on. Turn it on, then pair again.
